title: Measure the current local coordinator before changing it
hypothesis: A high-level coordinator driving the pinned offline model can finish the fixed local search without hosted calls and with lower latency, fewer steps, and fewer coordinator tokens than browser-use and Grok 4.7.
implementation_plan: Keep the current runtime fixed for the measurement batch
Run local_search once per arm and write schema zero-browser.experiment-run.v1 records under results/experiment-loop/
Score the directory with scripts/experiment_scoreboard.py and follow its single next lever

target_rubrics.description: A run passes only when every independent check is true. The model DONE choice is ignored.
The local-coordinator arm records zero hosted model calls.

notes_for_agent: Do not treat a fast failure as a speedup. If Grok or Codex or Claude is not logged in, write a blocked record and continue the arms that can run. No live flight goal in this idea.
